selected_route: existing Context World State Controlled Integration boundary
Field Event Admission branch when an explicit field-relevant candidate exists
Field State Reducer only for admitted field events and future state candidate
CurrentWorldCandidateV1 referencing Context and Field State
why_selected: existing synthetic C01-C36 path already implements the downstream handoff shape
Observation Gateway owns evidence admission and routing
Context Foundation already accepts observation and field projections without mutation
Field Event Admission and Field State Reducer preserve the canonical state authority
Current World already derives a candidate from Context and Field State references

rejected_routes.A_gateway_to_context_direct: rejected because Context Foundation is not the evidence admission owner and direct bypass would lose gateway admission semantics
rejected_routes.B_gateway_to_field_event_reducer_as_defa: rejected as the universal route because not every visual detection is field-relevant and raw/model output cannot enter the reducer; use only the governed field-relevant branch
rejected_routes.C_gateway_to_current_world_direct: rejected because Current World is a derived candidate and must not bypass Context, Field Event Admission, or Field State references
